creator: kanak_gurnani
caption:
Kids love cheese balls… but who says they need to be deep-fried? 🧀😍

These Non-Fried Cheese Balls are crispy outside, cheesy inside & loaded with veggies! ❤️

And the best part? No deep frying!

Just a little oil and your good old appe pan. ✨

Perfect for after-school hunger, evening snacks or weekend cravings!

Same cheesy goodness, just a healthier twist! 😋

📌 Save this recipe for your next snack time!

❤️ Detailed recipe pinned in comments!

hook.text: NON-FRIED CHEESE BALLS 🧀 Kids Will Love These!
hook.whyItWorks: No voice at all: the hook is the text card plus a cheese pull in the first 3 seconds. 'Non-fried' promises the guilt-free version of a snack everyone already craves, and 'kids will love these' speaks straight to the parent deciding what to make at 5pm. The stretchy cheese shot proves the promise before the recipe starts.

format.visualLayout: Overhead hands-only cooking on a wooden board, a text card pinned at the top the whole time, Hindi film song underneath, face reveal at the end
format.pacing: fast, about 1 cut every 1.5s across ~30 shots, then a 5s tasting shot to close
format.reasoning: A recipe is a sequence, so quick hands-only steps keep it moving without narration; the fixed text card means a muted viewer still knows the payoff. Showing the cheese pull first and the creator tasting last brackets the process with the two moments people actually want to see.

angle.angle: Turn a deep-fried party snack into an appe-pan version with veggies and a little oil
angle.commonBelief: Cheese balls have to be deep-fried to come out crisp
angle.contrarianTake: An appe pan with a little oil gives a crisp shell and a melty centre, and you can hide veggies inside

myVersion.script:
5pm hunger, chai in hand, pakoda on your mind? Make these in your appe pan instead.
Grate some paneer.
Add soaked moong dal, crushed in the mixer.
Chopped onion, capsicum, coriander.
Salt, chilli, a pinch of ajwain.
Bind it with a spoon of besan.
Roll small balls.
Brush the appe pan with a few drops of oil.
Turn them till they're golden on every side.
Crisp outside. Soft inside. Way more protein than a pakoda.
Dip in green chutney and enjoy your chai.
Save this for your next evening craving.
